title: crib-extended homophonic KPA -- exact forced/free entry & position accounting
hypothesis: under the 2-chart homophonic model the cribs force a larger guaranteed-determined free-position set than the bijective 3-chart model (098), because 2 charts each cover more crib letters
best_partial: forced-both 0-0/73 per colouring; 0 guaranteed across all 16384 colourings; ~14.5 free entries/chart
insights: Cribs hold 23 distinct (cipher->plain) pairs over 14 distinct cipher letters; 9 cipher letters are AMBIGUOUS (map to >1 plaintext: {'F': ['E', 'O'], 'R': ['S', 'T'], 'V': ['L', 'T'], 'Q': ['N', 'O'], 'P': ['C', 'R'], 'N': ['B', 'H'], 'K': ['A', 'K'], 'S': ['S', 'T'], 'T': ['I', 'N']}) -- these are exactly what force the 9 b-graph splits. Enumerated all 16,384 crib-feasible 2-colourings (exact, no sampling).

PER-CHART ENTRY ACCOUNTING: each homophonic chart has 26 cipher->plain entries; the cribs FORCE 9-14 of them in chart 0 and 9-14 in chart 1 (median 11.5/11.5), leaving ~14.5/14.5 entries FREE per chart. Non-injective free entries are the residual degrees of freedom (092/093).

FREE-POSITION DETERMINATION (of 73 free positions): per colouring, 0-0 are forced REGARDLESS of selector (cipher letter pinned identically in both charts); 30-30 are forced only on one selector branch. 30 free positions are touched by a crib letter at all.

GUARANTEED DETERMINED FLOOR: 0 free positions are forced to ONE consistent letter across ALL 16,384 crib-feasible colourings -- selector- AND colouring-independent. This is the exact homophonic determination floor; compare 098's bijective 3-chart consensus (sampled). The remaining free positions stay under-determined: the homophonic model escapes the bijective squeeze structurally (117) but the free chart entries leave decryption multiplicity (the honest gap).
next_steps: 119: homophonic determinacy floor as a per-position probability over the full model space (exact enumeration) head-to-head with 098, plus a decrypt-multiplicity census
